## About me

I'm MAO Xilin, a Statistics PhD student at Qiuzhen College, Tsinghua University, advised by Professor Yang Yuhong. Before coming to Tsinghua University, I received my Bachelor's degree in Mathematics from University of Chinese Academy of Sciences.

I have a broad interest in mathematics, computer science, and physics. Currently, my main focus is on statistical problems, especially statistical theories related to causal inference and large language models.

## Research interests {.research-interests}

- Data integration in Causal inference
- Policy learning and Preference learning
- Model Averaging, Model Selection
- Reward modeling in RLHF
